description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing the home screen of a learning app, including UI components such as an animated header, lessons list, progress summaries, and navigation logic.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the main interface for the home page, displaying greetings, lessons, and progress summaries.

classes.description: State class controlling the animation lifecycle for _AnimatedAppear.
